name: p-token-migrator
description: End-to-end p-token migration toolkit with scanner, simulator, dashboard, and Rust CLI.

scripts.build: npm run build:engine && npm run build:frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:engine && npm run build:frontend && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning src/server.ts
scripts.cli:sample: cargo run -p solana-token-analyzer --bin sta -- scan samples/anchor-token-vault --out data/cli-sample-manifest.json --summary
